description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Maria
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Galaxia XCIX (0~2), removed after using Galaxia XCIX two times

description.name: Galaxia XCIX Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Galaxia XCIX level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Earth abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Maria]

description.name: Galaxia XCIX Level
description.text: Keeps track of Galaxia XCIX level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Maria]
